raw_block.rationale: Jointly targets all three trigger failures: a focused airline calculator uses separate current-source reads so position fees and excess-fee bands are less likely to be omitted, while an Illinois-specific residual-property planner prevents misclassification under the wearing-apparel provision and emits either EC or EV native output. The airline helper also preserves and can improve the history airline case because it applies the same route, cabin, size, weight, and higher-excess-fee rules.
